## Introduction

Crossfitting example. This include three treatments and interactions. All effects can be set to zero (or some small quantity)

- Treatments:
  - Three linear treatments + interactions
  - Continuous
- Confounders:
  - Two linear confounders
  - Continuous

$$\mathbb{E}[Y\vert{}T,X] = \beta_1 T_1 + \beta_2 T_2 + \beta_{int12} (T_1 \times T_2) + \beta_{int13} (T_1 \times T_3) + \beta_{int23} (T_2 \times T_3) + g(X)$$ 

### Data set up

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(42)
library(tidyverse)
library(sjPlot)
```

```{r}
n <- 10000

## Confounders (X)
x1 <- rnorm(n)
x2 <- rnorm(n)
```

```{r}
## Continuous Treatments (correlated with confounders)
t1 <- 0.5 * x1 + 0.3 * x2 + rnorm(n, sd = 0.5)
t2 <- -0.4 * x1 + 0.6 * x2 + rnorm(n, sd = 0.5)
t3 <- 0.2 * x1 - 0.2 * x2 + rnorm(n, sd = 0.5)
```

```{r}
## Outcome
beta_t1 <- 2.0
beta_t2 <- 3.5
beta_t3 <- -1.5
beta_int12 <- 1.2
beta_int13 <- 0
beta_int23 <- 0

y <- (beta_t1 * t1) + 
  (beta_t2 * t2) + 
  (beta_t3 * t3) + 
  (beta_int12 * (t1 * t2)) + 
  (beta_int13 * (t1 * t3)) + 
  (beta_int23 * (t2 * t3)) + 
  (1.5 * x1 + 2.0 * x2) + 
  rnorm(n)

# Combine into a data frame
df <- data.frame(y = y, t1 = t1, t2 = t2, t3 = t3, 
                 t1t2 = t1 * t2, t1t3 = t1 * t3, t2t3 = t2 * t3, 
                 x1 = x1, x2 = x2)
```


### Cross-fitting 

First run a cross-fitting loop where we orthogonalize the treatments and the interaction

```{r}
nfolds <- 5
folds <- sample(rep(1:nfolds, length.out = n))

## Store expected values
hat_t1 <- rep(NA, n)
hat_t2 <- rep(NA, n)
hat_t3 <- rep(NA, n)
hat_t1t2 <- rep(NA, n)
hat_t1t3 <- rep(NA, n)
hat_t2t3 <- rep(NA, n)
hat_y  <- rep(NA, n)

## Loop over the folds
for (k in 1:nfolds) {
  train_id <- which(folds != k)
  eval_id  <- which(folds == k)
  
  train_data <- df[train_id, ]
  eval_data  <- df[eval_id, ]
  
  ## Outcome model
  model_y  <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2, data = train_data)
  ## Propensity models
  model_t1 <- lm(t1 ~ x1 + x2, data = train_data)
  model_t2 <- lm(t2 ~ x1 + x2, data = train_data)
  model_t3 <- lm(t3 ~ x1 + x2, data = train_data)
  model_t1t2 <- lm(t1t2 ~ x1 + x2, data = train_data)
  model_t1t3 <- lm(t1t3 ~ x1 + x2, data = train_data)
  model_t2t3 <- lm(t2t3 ~ x1 + x2, data = train_data)

  ## Get predicted values
  hat_y[eval_id]  <- predict(model_y, newdata = eval_data)
  hat_t1[eval_id] <- predict(model_t1, newdata = eval_data)
  hat_t2[eval_id] <- predict(model_t2, newdata = eval_data)
  hat_t3[eval_id] <- predict(model_t3, newdata = eval_data)
  hat_t1t2[eval_id] <- predict(model_t1t2, newdata = eval_data)
  hat_t1t3[eval_id] <- predict(model_t1t3, newdata = eval_data)
  hat_t2t3[eval_id] <- predict(model_t2t3, newdata = eval_data)
}

## Calculate residuals
df$res_y  <- df$y - hat_y
df$res_t1 <- df$t1 - hat_t1
df$res_t2 <- df$t2 - hat_t2
df$res_t3 <- df$t3 - hat_t3
df$res_t1t2 <- df$t1t2 - hat_t1t2
df$res_t1t3 <- df$t1t3 - hat_t1t3
df$res_t2t3 <- df$t2t3 - hat_t2t3
```

### Final stage model

```{r}
final_model <- lm(res_y ~ 0 + res_t1 + res_t2 + res_t3 + 
                    res_t1t2 + res_t1t3 + res_t2t3, data = df)

tab_model(final_model)
```

Sanity check on the full model w/ confounders

```{r}
single_model <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2 + t1 + t2 + t3 + t1:t2 + t1:t3 + t2:t3)

tab_model(single_model)
```
